facts.fact: an unbaked (memory) cloth cache is thrown away by these changes
cases: cloth quality set to its own value
cloth mass set to its own value
cloth object's hide_render set to its own value
cloth object's hide_viewport toggled off and on
collider's location set to its own value
Subdivision modifier added after the cloth
Subdivision added after the cloth, levels 0 and render levels 0

facts.fact: an unbaked cloth cache survives these
cases: frame_set to the frame already current
camera (unrelated object) location set to its own value
a new object added to the scene
material's Base Color edited (material made before the simulation)
